name: Padma-Nathan 2008
question: Does nightly sildenafil after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy improve unassisted erectile function after treatment ends?

design.population: Men with normal preoperative erectile function after bilateral nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy; 76 completed endpoint assessment.
design.locator: Padma-Nathan 2008, PubMed abstract, Methods and Results; 76 and arm counts are completers

verdictNote: Early closure and a completer analysis limit the positive endpoint.
takeaway: Nightly sildenafil 50 or 100 mg after bilateral nerve-sparing prostatectomy yielded unassisted erections after washout in 14/51 completers (27%), versus 1/25 (4%) with placebo; enrollment stopped early.

reports.label: Nocturnal-erection subanalysis
reports.citation: McCullough AR, Levine LA, Padma-Nathan H. "Return of Nocturnal Erections and Erectile Function after Bilateral Nerve-sparing Radical Prostatectomy in Men Treated Nightly with Sildenafil Citrate: Subanalysis of a Longitudinal Randomized Double-blind Placebo-controlled Trial." *J Sex Med.* 2008;5(2):476-484. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2007.00700.x
reports.followUp: 36 weeks of treatment followed by 8 weeks without ED treatment; assessment at postoperative week 48

results.endpoint: Unassisted erectile-function response in nocturnal-tumescence subset
results.measure: Postoperative week-48 response after 8-week washout, by nightly dose
results.note: The 54-man subset underwent penile plethysmography; tip rigidity at or above 55% best separated responders from nonresponders.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Padma-Nathan H, McCullough AR, Levine LA, et al. "Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of postoperative nightly sildenafil citrate for the prevention of erectile dysfunction after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy." *Int J Impot Res.* 2008;20(5):479-486. doi:10.1038/ijir.2008.33
reports.followUp: 36 weeks of nightly treatment from postoperative week 4, then 8-week drug-free assessment at week 48

results.measure: IIEF questions 3 and 4 combined score at least 8 plus satisfactory-sexual-activity response, after 8-week drug-free period
results.note: Fisher exact test; prespecified significance threshold and randomized arm denominators unavailable in abstract.

delivery.label: Treatment schedule
delivery.value: Nightly sildenafil 50 or 100 mg or placebo began 4 weeks after surgery, continued for 36 weeks, and was followed by an 8-week drug-free period.

delivery.label: Premature closure
delivery.value: Enrollment ceased prematurely after a blinded interim review; 76 men completed assessment.
